t: What Biological Pathway Uncertainty Database Is All About
title: What Biological Pathway Uncertainty Database Is All About
description: Biology is full of honest uncertainty: pathways drawn in textbooks may be wrong, incomplete, or true only in one cell type. The amyloid hypothesis of Alzheimer's has dominated for decades yet drugs targeting it kept failing. Good science marks the disputed edges: what three labs disagree on, what's never been tested in vivo, and where the arrows are guesses. Uncertainty mapped is uncertainty manageable. This database is the complete pathway uncertainty: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
definition: Biological Pathway Uncertainty Database: a complete reference database of full pathway uncertainty records.
key_points: What this database holds: full pathway uncertainty records, each with definition, key facts, and a runnable demo program.
